title: Can I use Ecovacs without Wi-Fi?
desc: Yes, you can use an Ecovacs robotic vacuum cleaner without a Wi-Fi connection. Basic functions such as start, pause, and stop can be controlled using the physical buttons on the device. However, advanced features like remote control, mapping, and establishing no-go zones require a Wi-Fi connection to be fully activated.

title: How to troubleshoot Ecovacs DEEBOT Vacuum Cleaner?
desc:
To restart and reset your vacuum, follow these steps:
  1. Turn off the vacuum and unplug it from the power source.
  2. Wait for a few minutes before turning it back on. Sometimes, a simple restart can fix temporary issues. Additionally, check if your Deebot has a reset button or function, and try resetting it to the default settings.

title: What are the negatives of robot vacuum cleaners?
desc: Inefficient Cleaning: Robot vacuums can sometimes struggle in corners or on thick carpets. They may miss spots or require multiple passes. Additionally, they may have limited dustbin capacity and can get stuck on obstacles.

title: Is it okay to run a robot Vacuum Cleaner every day?
desc: It depends on how often you set it to clean. If you set it to clean every day, the Eco setting should be sufficient. If you clean a few times a week, use the Normal setting. For once-a-week cleaning, the Max setting is recommended.

title: How do I know when my Ecovacs WINBOT Vacuum Cleaner is fully charged?
desc: When the WINBOT switch is in the 'I' (on) position, a blinking blue indicator light means that the WINBOT is charging. If all the indicator lights are off, this indicates that the robot is fully charged and has entered Sleep mode. You can activate the WINBOT by pressing the Power button.

title: Can you use DEEBOT Vacuum Cleaner without internet?
desc: Advanced features such as remote control, mapping, and setting no-go zones require internet access to be fully activated. After the initial setup, DEEBOT and other robot vacuums can still operate offline using the physical start button, but customization options and smart features will not be available.

title: Can DEEBOT Vacuum Cleaner work in the dark?
desc: Yes, DEEBOTs effectively operate on dark floors due to their True Mapping technology and advanced components, including dToF laser sensors and LiDAR.
